name: Daniel Mérida
intro: Daniel Mérida is a young tennis player from Madrid, Spain. Friends call him Dani. This year he won his very first ATP tournament.
story: One year ago, Dani had never played a match on the big tour. Then in April he zoomed all the way to a final in Bucharest. In July he won his first title in Umag, Croatia. Only Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner won there younger this decade! This was his first US Open main draw. He won two matches in New York. Not bad for a rookie!

funFacts.text: His birthday is September 26. He turns 22 three weeks after the US Open.
He is from Madrid, the capital city of Spain.
He grew up at the Chamartín tennis club in Madrid.
His best tennis friends, Rafa and Martín, trained at his club. They have played each other since age eight.
2026 was his first year playing all four Grand Slams. Those are the four biggest tournaments.
He won his first ATP title in Umag, Croatia. It was only his seventh tour event.
His first big final was against Mariano Navone, who is also in this guide!

watchFor: Watch him crush the ball from the back of the court.
